item.description: The AXS class is missing the 'udot' attribute that is referenced in test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_1, causing an AttributeError. The test expects the AXS object to have a 'udot' attribute but it doesn't exist in the current implementation.
item.contract: The AXS class must include a 'udot' attribute (similar to other permission attributes like uread, uwrite, etc.) to support dotfile access control. This attribute should be a set that stores usernames who have dotfile access permissions.

item.description: Configuration parsing in _parse_config_file method has issues with section header validation and user list parsing. Tests test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_2 and test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_3 fail due to invalid section header detection and improper comma-separated user list handling.
item.contract: Configuration parsing must correctly validate section headers and properly parse comma-separated user lists. Section headers should be validated against valid formats, and user lists should be parsed correctly to allow spaces and commas while rejecting invalid characters.

item.description: The _read_vol_str method in AuthSrv class has incomplete handling of dot notation in permission specifications, which affects test_dots.py::TestHttpCli::test. The method doesn't properly process dot notation patterns like "r.,u2" where the dot indicates special handling.
item.contract: The _read_vol_str method must properly handle dot notation in permission specifications by correctly interpreting patterns like "r.,u2" where the dot separates permissions from special flags and ensuring proper flag processing.

item.description: Test test_vfs.py::TestVFS::test fails due to an unhandled exception in VFS.get method when checking access permissions. The test expects proper handling of access control scenarios but the current implementation throws an exception instead.
item.contract: The VFS.get method must properly handle access control checks and return appropriate responses instead of throwing exceptions for valid access scenarios.

item.description: Tests test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_4 and test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_5 fail due to invalid config handling and user account parsing issues in the configuration parsing logic. These tests involve complex user/group management and IdP integration.
item.contract: Configuration parsing must properly handle complex user/group scenarios including IdP user integration and multi-group membership. The parser should correctly validate and process user accounts in various configurations.
